build_model_arch_config: build a ModelArchitectureConfig from a Hugging Face PretrainedConfig using ModelArchConfigConvertorBase
get_torch_dtype_from_config: get the torch dtype from a Hugging Face config, falling back to safetensors weight metadata if needed
convert_config_for_model_type: convert a Hugging Face config to vLLM ModelArchitectureConfig for a specific model type like falcon or mpt
get_quantization_config: get and normalize the quantization config from a Hugging Face config supporting modelopt and compressed-tensors
derive_max_model_len: derive the maximum model length from a Hugging Face config by checking multiple possible attribute keys
